title: Beaches & Nature
desc: Explore pristine beaches, coral reefs, and the island's unique flora and fauna.
extendedDesc: Nauru's coastline is lined with stunning white-sand beaches and vibrant coral reefs, perfect for snorkeling, diving, and relaxation. The interior features dramatic phosphate pinnacles and lush tropical vegetation waiting to be explored.

title: Food & Dining
desc: Sample local cuisine blending Pacific flavors with international influences.

title: Activities & Adventures
desc: From sport fishing to island hikes, discover adventures around every corner.

title: Travel Tips & Essentials
desc: Practical advice on packing, local customs, money, and staying connected.

title: Language & Culture
desc: Learn basic Nauruan phrases and understand the island's rich cultural heritage.
